title: A Table view of the project's cards
text: Besides the canvas and Parked, a project now has a Table view: every card on any canvas and each plan workstream as a row, with state, priority, canvas, plan, group, category, complexity and last update. Any column sorts with a click, in each value's own order, and a toolbar searches titles and filters by state, priority and canvas. A click on a row opens the card just as it opens on the canvas. The view is part of the address, so a link or a reload comes back to the table.
